Dermalogica's Virtual Assistant · AI says:
We’ll gladly accept returns for any Dermalogica.com purchase for any reason, as long as you initiate the return within 30 days of your order date.
Return shipping, handling, and restocking fees are not charged when you follow our return process.
Only new or gently used items in their original packaging are eligible. Items that are nearly empty, damaged or lost from personal use, or tampered/filled with other substances will not be refunded.
Some items are final sale and non‑refundable: partial kits or gift sets, free samples, gift-with-purchase items, and rewards items.
To get a refund, submit your return through our online returns center to generate a prepaid UPS label, repackage the items with the packing slip, and ship via UPS. Once we receive your return, we’ll process your refund for all eligible items marked for return.
If an order has already been processed and cannot be canceled, you can still return it through our return center for a full refund of all items you choose to return.
If you return a product or an order is canceled, any loyalty points from that purchase will be reversed or reduced, and your rewards tier may be adjusted.
If you purchased through a salon, spa, or another website, you’ll need to follow their return and refund policy.
